title: 01 Hook: the token trades, the stock doesn't
intent: Full-frame type on plain ground. Left half 'NVDA · Nasdaq · CLOSED (Saturday)', right half 'NVDAx · X Layer · trading' with a live-ish onchain price row. Three fact cards rise in one at a time, each with its source line. Slow push-in. Cut to the app on the last card.

title: 02 What Intatto is: the live Market page
intent: Real recording, intatto.larinova.com Market at 1440x900 inside a plain browser frame. Push in on the session pill, 'Max LTV for new loans' and the fixed 65% threshold, then the price-relay disclosure. Name card 'Intatto' over the first second. Label: LIVE · X Layer mainnet.

title: 03 Live mainnet position and its transactions
intent: Real recording. Borrow page connected read-only as demo wallet 0x7F23…a415: 0.004878 NVDAx, 0.40 USDG debt, 36% LTV, health 1.79, liquidation price. Type an amount to show the preview; nothing is sent. Cut to OKLink: the real borrow tx 0xa933…0f45 and the verified contract tab. Label: LIVE · mainnet.

title: 04 Sandbox: make it Saturday, refused, repay works
intent: Real recording of the hosted sandbox. Start a session (burner funded from a real holder), borrow on a weekday, press Jump to Saturday: the pill turns CLOSED and capacity drops. Try to borrow more: 'Refused: SessionLimit'. Repay succeeds. Label: SANDBOX · fork of X Layer mainnet on every frame.

title: 05 Fork proof turns green
intent: Real recording of /sandbox/proof: the checks run in the browser and turn green one after another (same block hash, same bytecode, same state, same Intatto code), then the 'everything we changed' ledger. Label: SANDBOX.

title: 06 DeepSeek Monday replay: nobody liquidated
intent: Real recording. Sandbox: Replay the January 2025 gap. Ledger fills with the CFD source; cut to the Risk console: the scenario loan ends near 60% LTV, under 65%, zero liquidations, reserve untouched. Label: REPLAY · CFD data (Dukascopy NVDA minute bars, 24 and 27 Jan 2025).

title: 07 Synthetic 45% gap: slices, reserve, deficit
intent: Real recording. Run the synthetic 45% gap; Risk console shows liquidation slices; Lend shows the reserve paid and the lender deficit with the share price drop. Label: SYNTHETIC · not market data.

title: 08 OKX AI: an agent asks, the keeper posts
intent: Real recording. The Agents page and a live call to /api/credit for the demo wallet; the JSON answer highlights session, borrowable now, liquidation price and gap. Then the Risk console / keeper log with a post every minute and OKLink tx links.

title: 09 Close: why X Layer, what's next, the name
intent: Plain type. Three evidence lines with sources, 'Next: Chainlink Data Streams live, more tickers', then the wordmark Intatto and intatto.larinova.com. Hold 3 s on the URL.
